ranked_opportunities.title: AI-powered compliance automation for SMBs
ranked_opportunities.rationale: Strong market size, regulatory tailwinds, clear differentiation path via AI-native architecture, solid exit potential ($100-500M). Multiple market signals: SEC enforcement surge, Series A funding activity, LinkedIn hiring trends.

ranked_opportunities.title: Vertical AI for healthcare supply chain optimization
ranked_opportunities.rationale: Larger TAM than compliance automation, but execution complexity slightly higher (hardware integration). Portfolio alignment strong in healthcare vertical. Exit potential: $50-200M acquisition by healthcare IT player.

ranked_opportunities.title: Real-time fraud detection for payment networks
ranked_opportunities.rationale: Moderate TAM, competitive intensity higher (8 direct competitors), but defensible moat possible via machine learning superiority. Exit potential: $200-500M acquisition by payment processor or bank.

reconsider_opportunities.title: Sustainability tracking for supply chains
reconsider_opportunities.rationale: Market emerging but regulatory clarity uncertain. Requires additional analysis on customer willingness-to-pay before advancement decision.

reconsider_opportunities.title: AI-powered contract review for legal departments
reconsider_opportunities.rationale: Legal tech market competitive with 12+ players. Differentiation opportunity exists but requires deeper analysis of enterprise GTM viability.

reconsider_opportunities.title: Workforce optimization for manufacturing
reconsider_opportunities.rationale: Strong problem statement but TAM confidence only 0.58 (below 0.6 threshold). Hold for additional market research before scoring decision.

reconsider_opportunities.title: Cybersecurity for healthcare IoT devices
reconsider_opportunities.rationale: Multiple regulatory uncertainties in healthcare device market. Requires portfolio review of execution risk tolerance.

reconsider_opportunities.title: Customer retention AI for DTC brands
reconsider_opportunities.rationale: Score at threshold boundary (60). Portfolio strategic fit unclear; recommend leadership review before advancing.

reconsider_opportunities.title: Predictive maintenance for industrial equipment
reconsider_opportunities.rationale: Hardware dependency increases capital requirements. Recommend deeper analysis of CAC/LTV before advancing.

rejected_opportunities.title: Blockchain-based supply chain tracking
rejected_opportunities.rationale: Unproven customer demand (LTV/CAC 0.17 vs. 3.0 threshold), dominant incumbent (Walmart Food Trust), 47+ competitors, speculative TAM (0.45 confidence), regulatory uncertainty.

rejected_opportunities.title: VR training platform for enterprise
rejected_opportunities.rationale: Hardware-dependent solution with capital-intensive manufacturing. Portfolio lacks VR infrastructure expertise. Exit potential unclear.

rejected_opportunities.title: Cryptocurrency custody for institutional investors
rejected_opportunities.rationale: Regulatory path highly uncertain (>50% ambiguity). Compliance burden prohibitive without established fintech licensing. Policy exception (soft filter: regulatory ambiguity) triggered.

rejected_opportunities.title: AI-powered fashion recommendation engine
rejected_opportunities.rationale: Consumer-focused (outside portfolio focus on B2B). Requires consumer marketing expertise. CAC high ($200K) relative to LTV ($15K/lifetime).

rejected_opportunities.title: Autonomous delivery robots for urban logistics
rejected_opportunities.rationale: Hardware-dependent, capital-intensive ($500M+ to scale), regulatory approval path unclear. Requires breakthrough in autonomous vehicles (non-core area).

rejected_opportunities.title: Social media analytics for consumer brands
rejected_opportunities.rationale: TAM <$100M (below minimum threshold), 15+ competitors, undifferentiated offering. Market saturated with low barriers to entry.
